text: Hello, boys and girls.I'm Helen.Welcome to my English class.Please prepare your student's book, your workbook, your notebook, and your stationery.Today, we are going to have the module revision, period one, talking about my friend.First of all, let's review the sounds.We have learnt SKSK in unit one.Please follow me.SKSK, desk, mask.Quite good.Now watch the video, listen and follow.SK, desk, mask.Martin sits at his desk, making a funny mask.Is it nice?his grandma asks.She puts on the mask, and Martin laughs.Very good.We have learnt SPSP in unit two.SPSP, wasp, crisps.Now watch, listen and follow.SP, wasp, crisps.Listen, little wasps.These are my crisps.Please go away.It's not a good day for wasps.To play are my crisps.We have learnt STST in unit three.STST, toast, postman, lamp post.Good.Watch, listen and follow again.ST, postman, lamp post.ST, toast, postman, ST.Lamp post.Near the lamp post, there's a post office.In the post office, there's a postman.The postman in the post office is eating a piece of toast.You can read quite well.Look at these people.How do they feel?Let's look at Martin first.How does Martin feel?Is he happy or tired?Yes, he is happy.How about this boy?Is he sad or thirsty?Right, he is happy.Right, he is sad.Look at the postman.Wow, he is hungry.He is eating a piece of toast.After eating, he feels full.Happy and sad are objects.Hungry and full are objects too.Please read and spell these words by yourself.Wonderful.Look, this is my friend.She wants to introduce herself.Please listen carefully, then think about these questions.Who is my friend?How old is my friend?What does my friend look like?Maybe she is tall.Maybe her eyes are big and bright.The last question.What can my friend do?Listen carefully.My name is Kitty.I am nine years old.I am thin.My hair is long.My student number is 15.I can read and write.I can swing fast and jump high.I can draw well, but I can't paint.Now let's check the answers.Right, Kitty is my friend.Yes, she is nine years old.Good, she thinks her hair is long.Yes, she can read, write, swing fast, jump high and draw.They are Kitty's abilities.Now look at these words.Read, read.Write, write.Draw, draw.Swim, swim.Jump, jump.From the answers, we know something about my friend's name, age, appearance and abilities.Do you want to know more about my friend except her name, age, appearance and abilities?Please read the passage and try to find out more information.Can you find more information about my friend Kitty?Let's read these sentences first.What can't my friend Kitty do?Right, she can't paint.Can you spell the word paint?Good, paint, paint.What's my friend's student number?Yes, her student number is 15.We have learned 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 16.Please read and spell these words.Pay attention to TEEN.Good, after reading, we also know my friend's student numberAnd what she can't do.Kitty is my friend.She wants to introduce her friend.So she has written a passage about her.From the passage, we will know the name, the age, the appearance, student number and abilities.Now please read and finish the information card of Kitty's friend on your notebook.Please open your notebook.Now read and write.Good, after reading, we also know the name, the age, the appearance, student number and abilities.Please read and finish the information card of Kitty's friend on your notebook.Good, now let's check the answers.Who is your friend, Kitty?My friend is Jill.How old is your friend?She is 10 years old.What does your friend look like?She is thin.Her hair is short.What's your friend's student number?Her student number is 16.What can your friend do?She can play basketball well, but she can't paint.Thank you, Kitty.Now pay attention to this sentence.It's about Kitty's friend Jill's hobbies.What does Jill like doing?Yes, she likes reading and dancing.Jill is my new friend.If you want to introduce your new friend, you can think about these questions.Please read the questions by yourself.You also can ask, can your new friend?I think all of you have friends.Now please finish an information card of your friend.Then ask an answer with your classmate.After that, I think you can make more new friends.My student, Taurus, has finished the information card.Let's ask him about his friend.Hello, Taurus.Hello, Helen.Please answer my questions about your friend.Okay.Who is your friend?Victor is my friend.He is 10 years old.He is short and thin.My friend's student number is 23.He can play tennis.Can your friend swim?Yes, he can.Can your friend paint?No, he can't.What does your friend like doing?He likes singing and running.Thank you, Taurus.Bye bye.In today's class, we have talked about my friends.I have many friends.I love my friends.And they love me too.Very good, boys and girls.The assignment for today.Finish the exercises on page 20 and 21 of your workbook.Part A, B and D.So much for today.Bye bye, boys and girls.See you next time.Bye bye, Taurus.
